name: Jean Gangvang II
original_name: ジャン・ギャンバン二世
source:
Jean Gangvang II is the son of Duke Gangvang, an influential noble from the Kingdom of Leazas.

A haughty and arrogant nobleman, Jean spend much of his time abusing his father's wealth and status to force others to cater to his every whim. 

[spoiler]Jean become fascinated by [url=/c50945]Yulang Mirage[/url], the champion gladiator of the Leazas Coliseum, a woman renowned for both her great strength and exceptional beauty. Jean approached Yulang multiple times and attempted to convince her to retire from her career as a gladiator to become both his personal bodyguard and his wife, but was routinely rejected by the female warrior, who was only interested in strong men. [/spoiler]

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Jean_Gangvang_II]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
